backend/main.mo: Main backend actor implementing product management, cart operations, order processing, mobile recharge, and role-based access control (admin/user) with blob storage integration.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report documenting two high-confidence features: replacing the homepage hero banner with IMG_20251019_102908.png and updating the header logo with Gemini_Generated_Image_rjk9furjk9furjk9.png.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: JSON-formatted summaries of all frontend files describing components, pages, hooks, and styling with details about uploaded images, contact number updates, and functionality.
frontend/index.css: Global Tailwind CSS styles defining OKLCH color palette with warm, earthy tones for light and dark modes, plus custom design tokens for the grocery store theme.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point with page title 'Maa Bhawani General Store & Banking Point' and root div for React mounting.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root application component configuring TanStack Router with routes for home, checkout, order confirmation, store details, and admin pages wrapped in Layout.
frontend/src/components/AdminGuard.tsx: Authorization wrapper component that checks Internet Identity authentication and admin role, displaying error alerts for unauthorized access to admin panel.
frontend/src/components/AdminProductForm: Form component for adding products with name, category selection, price input, image file upload with progress tracking, and validation before submission.
frontend/src/components/AdminProductList: Table component displaying all products with images, details, and delete functionality with confirmation dialog, including loading skeletons and empty state.
frontend/src/components/CallUsButton.tsx: A fixed floating button in the bottom-right corner that triggers a phone call to 9142876085 when clicked.
frontend/src/components/CartDrawer.tsx: A slide-out drawer component displaying cart items with quantities, prices, subtotal calculation, and buttons to proceed to checkout or clear the cart.
frontend/src/components/CategoryFilter.t: A horizontally scrollable list of category filter buttons that allows users to select and filter products by category.
An informational alert component displaying the store's delivery policy: free within 1km, ₹20 per km beyond.
frontend/src/components/Footer.tsx: A footer component with three columns showing store info, contact details with phone/map links, delivery info, and a copyright notice with caffeine.ai attribution.
frontend/src/components/Header.tsx: The main navigation header with store logo/name, navigation links, cart button with item count badge, and login/logout functionality using Internet Identity.
frontend/src/components/Layout.tsx: A layout wrapper component that combines Header, Footer, and CallUsButton with a gradient background and centers the main content.
frontend/src/components/MobileRechargeSe: A form component for mobile recharge orders with fields for phone number, operator selection, and amount, submitting recharge requests to the backend.
frontend/src/components/PaymentQRCode.ts: Displays a payment QR code image with the total amount and step-by-step UPI payment instructions for customers.
frontend/src/components/PhoneNumberSetup: Empty component file with no content.
frontend/src/components/ProductCard.tsx: A card component displaying a single product with image, category badge, name, price, and an 'Add to Cart' button that requires authentication.
frontend/src/components/ProductGrid.tsx: Displays a grid of products with category filtering, loading skeletons, and empty state handling using the ProductCard component.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: React hook that creates and manages an authenticated actor instance for backend communication, initializing access control with an admin token and invalidating dependent queries when the actor changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides Internet Identity authentication context and hooks for login/logout, managing identity state and delegation validation with configurable AuthClient options.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Defines React Query hooks for all backend operations including products, cart management, orders, and recharge orders with automatic cache invalidation.
frontend/src/index.css: Tailwind CSS configuration with custom CSS variables defining a warm, earthy color palette for light and dark themes suitable for a grocery store interface.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that sets up React Query and Internet Identity providers, then renders the root App component.
frontend/src/pages/AdminPage.tsx: Admin dashboard with tabs for managing products, viewing orders and recharge orders, displaying summary statistics including total orders, recharge orders, and revenue.
frontend/src/pages/CheckoutPage.tsx: Checkout form for placing orders with delivery details, distance-based delivery fee calculation, and validation before order submission with navigation to confirmation page.
frontend/src/pages/HomePage.tsx: Main landing page displaying a store banner image, mobile recharge section, and product grid for browsing groceries.
frontend/src/pages/OrderConfirmationPage: Displays order confirmation with order ID, payment QR code, next steps instructions, and action buttons to continue shopping or call the store. Retrieves order total from sessionStorage.
frontend/src/pages/StoreDetailsPage.tsx: Shows comprehensive store information including contact details, location with embedded Google Maps, delivery policy (free within 1km, ₹20/km beyond), store hours, and available services.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility functions for extracting and managing URL parameters from both regular query strings and hash-based routing, with sessionStorage persistence support and parameter cleanup functionality.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration with custom color scheme using OKLCH color space, extended theme settings for borders/shadows/animations, and plugins for typography, container queries, and animations.
project_state.json: Project metadata defining an e-commerce grocery store application with features including product catalog, cart, ordering, admin panel, Google authentication with phone verification, mobile recharge, and distance-based delivery fees in INR.
